snippet.title: Iran Displays US & Israeli Aircraft Wreckage #iran #iranisraelwar #iranwar #f15 #missilestrike
snippet.description:
Iran's Revolutionary Guard has displayed the wreckage of several American and Israeli aircraft and drones that it claims were shot down during the ongoing conflict. Among the debris are what Iran identifies as an F-15 fighter jet canopy and ejection seat, along with the wreckage of several unmanned aircraft.

One of the most striking pieces is an Israeli Hermes 900 drone, which appears largely intact. Footage suggests the missile may have struck its rear section and damaged its propulsion system, causing the drone to lose the ability to fly rather than destroying the entire airframe in mid-air.

Iran has also displayed wreckage it identifies as MALE drones, designed for long-endurance surveillance and reconnaissance missions. However, the claims surrounding the displayed wreckage have not been independently verified, making it important to distinguish between Iran's claims and confirmed losses.

snippet.description:
